Required Qualifications: - 8+ years overall IT experience, with strong focus on Performance Engineering / Application Performance Management. - Proven experience troubleshooting complex performance issues in enterprise applications. - Deep understanding of JVM internals, memory management, threading, GC, CPU and I/O behavior. - Strong Linux troubleshooting skills. - Ability to independently perform performance analysis and identify root causes. - Experience working cross‑functionally with development, DevOps, infrastructure, and database teams.
